steps.name: Load counts/metadata, QC, and fit DESeq2 full vs reduced (interaction) models
caveats: 25 sample columns in counts vs 24 rows in metadata — verify and reconcile the discrepancy explicitly before fitting; do not silently drop or fabricate a match
With only 3 replicates per condition-time cell (n=24, 8 cells), the LRT for interaction has limited power for subtle effects — report this power limitation
pydeseq2 supports categorical factors with multiple levels and LRT-style contrasts via reduced design; confirm this in a quick capability check as part of the step before committing to the full run
steps.question: Which genes show a statistically significant condition-by-time interaction in the 2 condition x 4 timepoint (t0-t3), 3-replicate design, i.e. deviate from a shared/parallel time trend across the two conditions?
acceptance_criteria: Counts (12000 genes x up to 24-25 samples) and metadata (24 samples x condition, time, time_hours) are loaded and sample IDs are matched/aligned between the two files, with any mismatch (e.g. 25 count columns vs 24 metadata rows) explicitly reported and reconciled (drop unmatched sample) rather than silently assumed
Genes with all-zero or near-zero counts across samples are filtered prior to modeling

DESeq2 is fit with a full design ~condition + time + condition:time and a reduced design ~condition + time, using DESeq(test='LRT', reduced=reduced_design) on time treated as a categorical factor with 4 levels (t0-t3)
LRT p-values are BH-adjusted; output table has one row per gene with test statistic, raw p, padj, and per-condition:time interaction coefficients
A results CSV listing significant interaction genes (padj < 0.05) is produced, sorted by padj, with the number of significant genes reported explicitly (including if zero)
time is treated as a factor/categorical variable, not numeric, since only 4 discrete timepoints exist and dose/time-response shape is not assumed linear

steps.name: Extract normalized trajectories and cluster interaction genes by divergence pattern
caveats: Do not cluster if the interaction gene list from T1S1 is empty or too small (<10 genes) for meaningful clustering — report the limitation instead
steps.question: Among genes with significant condition:time interaction, what are the distinct temporal patterns of treatment-specific divergence (e.g., early vs late divergence, opposite-direction vs magnitude-only divergence) across t0-t3?
acceptance_criteria: Uses DESeq2 variance-stabialized or normalized counts (not raw counts) for the interaction-significant gene set from T1S1
For each significant gene, computes mean normalized expression per condition x timepoint cell (2x4 grid) and the condition-difference trajectory across t0-t3
Applies hierarchical or k-means clustering (unsupervised, with a justified k via elbow/silhouette) to group interaction genes into distinct temporal divergence patterns
Produces a heatmap or line-plot figure of condition-difference trajectories per cluster, plus a CSV mapping gene -> cluster assignment
Explicitly states the number of interaction genes carried forward from T1S1; if T1S1 found zero significant genes, this step reports that no clustering was possible rather than fabricating patterns

steps.name: Pathway enrichment of treatment-specific (interaction) genes using human WikiPathways
caveats: Reference WikiPathways GMT uses HGNC gene symbols — confirm counts.csv gene symbols match this namespace before running enrichment; report any symbol-matching loss
steps.question: Are the genes with significant condition-by-time interaction enriched in specific WikiPathways biological pathways, beyond genes driven by the shared time trend alone?
acceptance_criteria: Uses the interaction-significant gene list (padj<0.05) from T1S1 as the query set and all tested (non-filtered) genes from the counts matrix as the background/universe
Loads the human WikiPathways GMT file staged in the environment, parses the '%'-delimited descriptor field to recover readable pathway names and WikiPathways IDs

Runs an over-representation test (e.g., hypergeometric/Fisher via gseapy enrich or equivalent) comparing the interaction gene set to WikiPathways gene sets, using gene symbols matching the counts.csv first column
Reports a results table with pathway name, ID, overlap genes, p-value, and BH-adjusted q-value, sorted by q-value
If T1S1 yields zero or very few (<5) significant interaction genes, explicitly reports that enrichment is underpowered/not run rather than fabricating a pathway result

plan.title: Treatment x time interaction DE analysis (2x4 design)
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is bulk RNA-seq (salmon-derived raw counts, 12000 genes x 25 samples/24 annotated) with a 2-condition x 4-timepoint (t0-t3) x 3-replicate design. The research question — which genes change over time in a treatment-specific manner beyond the shared time trend — is a classic condition:time interaction question. This requires modeling gene expression as a function of condition, time, and their interaction using a negative-binomial GLM (DESeq2), with the likelihood-ratio test (LRT) comparing a full model (~condition*time) against a reduced model (~condition+time) to isolate genes whose time trajectory differs by condition, independent of genes that merely respond to time in both arms equally. After identifying interaction-significant genes, cluster their trajectories to characterize the direction/shape of divergence, and run pathway enrichment on the interaction gene set using human WikiPathways gene sets (present in refs) to interpret biology. Track 1 covers QC/normalization and the interaction DE test; Track 2 covers trajectory clustering and visualization; Track 3 covers functional enrichment of the resulting gene set.
